levels.description:
Redeployment Time <@ba.vup>-40%</>; If equipped by a [Kazimierz] Operator, enemies within Attack Range have <@ba.vup>-35%</> ASPD and <@ba.vup>-35%</> Movement Speed for 20s after skill activation
<@ba.acrem>If 'Kazimierz Knightclub Pennant' is also equipped by the [Kazimierz] Operator, while skill is active, Operator has ATK <@ba.vup>+100%</> and will not retreat when receiving lethal damage, instead retreating once skill ends</>
